taskNew.title: New Task
taskNew.quickPromptPlaceholder:
Enter agent instructions directly, e.g.:
Improve this project's README with usage examples

Will auto-approve, start right after creation, model from system config
taskNew.goalExpand: Set completion criteria (goal loop, auto-loop until met)
taskNew.goalPlaceholder: e.g. first word of the first paragraph of docs/foo.md is 'bar' (and nothing else changes)
taskNew.goalHintPostQuick: to the end of the instructions. A grader (small model) judges done / not_done / impossible each round; the agent can also write impossible in goal_report to stop early. Max 20 rounds (default).
taskNew.goalEmptyWarn: ⚠ goal_text is empty, this number has no effect
taskNew.dropzone: Drag files here, or click to select (uploaded automatically after task creation; agent reads by path)
taskNew.configTipDefault: Defaults: auto-approve · effort=high · 200 turns · working directory isolated automatically · model from personal/project config or env ANTHROPIC_MODEL
taskNew.titlePlaceholder: Fix login bug in auth module
taskNew.promptPlaceholder: Instructions actually sent to the agent...
taskNew.goalHintPostFull: If non-empty → after the agent finishes, a grader small model judges done/not_done/impossible and auto-continues until met (max 20 rounds, see settings.goal_*). See docs/usage/18-goal-loop.md.
taskNew.descPlaceholder: Task notes (optional, not sent to the agent)
taskNew.llmHint: Pick "Default" to resolve via the admin/project default chain; picking a specific config pins that one.
taskNew.modelPlaceholder: Empty = use the model in the LLM config
taskNew.roleHint: Manage in Settings → Roles; the task inherits the role's system_prompt and default parameters.
taskNew.autoAcceptCheckbox: Auto-accept on reviewing → completed (DAG projects only)
taskNew.autoAcceptHint: This project has no DAG topology scheduling; unavailable.
taskNew.depHint: This task starts only after its dependencies complete

snap.title: Templates
snap.empty: No snapshots yet. Click "New snapshot" to create the first one; or fill in "Full config" and click "Save as snapshot".
snap.versionHint: Required. Take the version ID from the project URL.
snap.errVersionNeedsProject: Version scope requires a project first
